subject: System
action: The system must reject chapter creation unless the requester is authenticated, the target work is owned by that requester, and any supplied folder is both in the same work and a `회차` folder node.
condition: When `submitCreateChapter(workId, title, folderId ?? null)` is invoked.
expectedOutcome: Only authorized creates against a valid owned work context can proceed to chapter creation.

subject: System
action: When a chapter is created successfully for a work, the chapter must receive the next `order_index` after that work's current maximum and the user must be routed to the created chapter detail screen.
expectedOutcome: The new chapter is placed at the end of the work's chapter order and becomes the next screen the user sees.

subject: System
action: The create-chapter submit action must remain unavailable while a submission is pending or while `title.trim()` is empty.
condition: While the new-chapter form is shown.
expectedOutcome: The user cannot trigger chapter creation until the title contains non-whitespace text and the pending state clears.

subject: System
action: The chapter list screen must fetch chapters only when an authenticated user is present; otherwise it must render using an empty chapter list.
expectedOutcome: Authenticated users can receive chapter data, while unauthenticated users do not trigger the chapter query from this screen.

subject: System
action: The chapter list must present non-deleted chapters for the selected work in ascending `order_index`, and it must provide navigation to both chapter detail and new-chapter creation routes.
condition: While the chapter list screen is displayed.
expectedOutcome: Users can review the ordered chapter set and open either an existing chapter or the create flow from this screen.

subject: System
action: The system must only attempt chapter reordering when the drag operation changes the order, and the reorder action must require an authenticated requester with a valid owned work context before it succeeds.
condition: When a drag-and-drop reorder ends on the chapter list screen.
expectedOutcome: No-op drops produce no reorder request, while valid reorder attempts are guarded by authentication and ownership checks before list revalidation on success.

subject: authenticated user
action: Create a new chapter in a work they own by submitting a required chapter title.

subject: authenticated user
action: View and organize the chapters of a work from the chapter list screen.
